text:
Alex P: Quick sync — final copy for the price page QA sprint. Need alignment before we push to staging tomorrow morning. :rocket:
Marta G: Agenda: FAQ phrasing, tier naming options (short + descriptive), calculator labels, webinar CTA copy, and inbound routing rules.
Ria - PM: I'll own rollout schedule. Can we lock copy by EOD so eng can deploy the static content?
Emma (designer): I'll patch the page microcopy after we lock. Two design asks: keep CTA buttons to 2 variants, and show tooltip text on price calc inputs.
Sam (growth): Webinar hook suggestion: "Live benchmark walkthrough — optimize inference costs". Link CTA -> gated signup. We should test gated vs open registration.
Marta G: For FAQ, can we trim legal-sounding lines? Example: change "Is billing prorated?" answer to "Yes — prorated for upgrades within the billing cycle." Shorter and clearer.
Alex P: Love that. Also want a one-line clarifier under tiers: "Pick what matches your throughput — change anytime."
Emma (designer): Microcopy proposal for calculator input labels: label1: "avg tokens / request", label2: "requests / min", helper: "est monthly spend". Short helpers only.
Zachops: Routing rules draft (for inbound leads via calc CTA and webinar signups):
```
- if lead.intent_score >= 80 -> route: sales.queue
- if 50 <= lead.intent_score < 80 -> route: growth-nurture
- if lead.intent_score < 50 -> route: marketing-nurture (drip)
- if company_size >= 500 -> tag: enterprise && route: account-exec
- source == "calculator" && est_monthly_spend >= 2000 -> priority: high
```
Sam (growth): +1 to routing. Suggest we also send a Slack alert to #sales-leads for priority high.
Ria - PM: Timeline: lock copy today, design updates tonight, engineered static push by 9am PDT tomorrow, then QA. Webinar landing draft needs final CTA wording before publish.
Marta G: Tier naming — two paths: descriptive (Starter / Scale / Dedicated) vs capability-first (Dev / Production / Enterprise). Which do we prefer?
Alex P: Prefer capability-first for clarity to engineers. Short names + one-liner under each.
Emma (designer): For the calculator modal, adjust button text: primary "Estimate cost" secondary "Compare tiers". Keep it consistent with page CTAs.
Sam (growth): For the webinar CTA microcopy test: variant A "Join benchmark webinar" vs variant B "See live cost-savings demo". We'll A/B these for CTR & sign quality.
Zachops: Implementation note for eng: add hidden param `calc_intent=true` on CTA so routing can pick source.
Alex P: Good call. Also add a small FAQ item pointing to webinar replays: "Missed the live session? Watch the recording."
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging: /pricing v1.13 at 2026-03-23 09:00 PDT.
Ria - PM: Next steps — Marta finalize FAQ bullets, Emma finish microcopy + assets, Zachops add routing rules + Slack alert, Sam set up webinar A/B variants, Alex to approve final content before 7pm.
Marta G: I'll drop the final FAQ doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aX-fake-link (comments enabled). Please add quick inline comments, not long threads. :memo:
Alex P: Thanks team — if we hit the timing we can tie this into next week's benchmark blog launch. :eyes:
